issues: The placeholder 'BRAND' is a generic all-caps, wide-tracked stand-in with no brand character; apart from that one line the frame is empty
The 'liquid' look is just one flowing linear gradient with no sense of material
The white flash is a uniform full-screen fade, reading as a soft edit rather than overexposure
The flat wordmark fades in on white like a second reveal, muddying the simplification idea
changes: Look = aurora dark show → cool-white paper sign-off; fictional wordmark 'Vela.' at 300px/800 with tight tracking, liquid and flat versions share size and position so it reads as the same mark being purified
Liquid-metal material: flowing iridescent base, vertical volume shading, chrome horizon band, one diagonal sheen clipped to the glyphs, bloom and a floor reflection over an aurora glow with dust

Added a charge-up beat 34–46f: the mark brightens ×1.7 and an anamorphic flare stretches out from its centre; the flash is now a radial white burst from the word (t² ease-in) with a 4f pure-white hold
Sign-off is an exposure recovery: the white layer recedes over 22f (quint-out) while the flat mark is already in place, only focusing 1.03→1 — no second reveal
Lock-up: an accent-violet rule draws, 'Interfaces, distilled.' rises word by word, eyebrow 'VELA DESIGN SYSTEM · 2.0'; last frame is a full brand lock-up; duration 108→120f
